contribution.position: Holding my earlier position: reliability remains mixed and unproven for this specific change. The test report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) and perf report (p99 within budget at peak load) are encouraging, but the incident log records two sev2 retry-storm incidents last quarter — the exact failure mode this queue change touches. Neither report exercises retry-storm behavior, so confidence in reliability requires evidence of behavior under retry-storm conditions (replay, chaos test, or load test simulating storm bursts). Note also the ops claim of a proven rollback path conflicts with the runbook, which shows no failover drill executed — that only strengthens the case that the retry-storm failure mode needs direct evidence.
